title: Voice mosaic synthesis and proposal stash - Nov 2026
content:
Context:
This doc aggregates raw customer snippets from support tickets, CSM calls, and in-product feedback collected Oct-Nov 2026. Goal is to surface distinct problem patterns, propose low-effort pilot fixes, and seed 2-3 med-effort feature proposals for product/eng to evaluate. Not polished — use as working stash for next CS <> Product sync (Nov 24).

Top themes (short):
- Latency tail pain on multi-step chat flows: several mid-market customers noticed 300–600ms spikes when model switching / tool-calling occurs. Pattern: longer histories + small bursts.
- Confusing model pinning semantics: customers expect "pin to variant" to persist across rollout policies; they end up getting fallbacks. Quote: "We pinned to q4-small but the canary swapped us mid-day — we lost determinism."
- Embedding freshness and cache invalidation: a retailer reported stale search results after model upgrade — prefix cache not invalidated.
- Cost-awareness docs gap: customers want prescriptive guidance for batching vs latency tradeoffs for small-scale deployments (50–200 requests/min).
- Operator UX for Dedicated: once capacity is near limit, teams want clearer guidance and an alpha alerting rule (thresholds+recommended mitigations).

Representative customer quotes (anonymized):
- "We love the throughput but sometimes responses hang for a long time. Hard to debug which layer caused it."
- "Pinning should be a contract. We can't have silent rollbacks during an incident."
- "Embedding mismatches after model switch costed us conversions — we need automatic reindex guidance."

Quick fixes (low effort, measurable):
1) Add a tooltip and short doc blurb on model pinning semantics and explicit override button in Console. (Owner: Product docs, effort: 1 sprint)
2) Add an ops-runbook snippet in Dedicated console: "Near-capacity checklist" with recommended action: increase burst pool, throttle lower-priority routes. (Owner: SRE/Eng, effort: 1 week doc + UI copy)
3) Provide a sample script to invalidate prefix/KV caches for embeddings after model upgrades (release as gist + console link). (Owner: Applied-ML, effort: 3 days)

Medium proposals (requires scoping):
A) Latency tail analyzer: lightweight tracing view that groups requests by sequence-length, model-variant, and tool-calls; surface percentiles + top contributing spans. Rationale: customers need actionable signals to tune batching/kv cache. Possible components: sampling tracer, small UI panel in Console, alert endpoint. (Estimated: 3–4 sprints)
B) Pinning contract mode: an explicit toggled mode where pinned routes are locked to exact model hash, with fallbacks disabled unless manually approved. Include audit log and canary-exclusion. (Estimated: 4–6 sprints; security review for rollback path)
C) Embedding migration assistant: automated reindex job that runs incremental compare and flags drift; provides rollback tips and cost estimate. Integrates with Optimize suggestions. (Estimated: 4 sprints)

Tradeoffs & open questions:
- Latency analyzer sampling adds instrumentation cost and slight request overhead — what are acceptable sampling rates? (ask Eng-obs)
- Pin-locks increase blast radius if a model becomes unhealthy — what auto-evac policy is safe? (SRE input needed)
- Reindex job cost should be displayed to customers; need billing guardrails.

Immediate next steps (action list):
- Nov 22: CS/Product sync to prioritize A/B/C (Lead: Aisha).
- Nov 24: Share quick-fix doc snippets with affected customers; include how-to cache invalidate script (Owner: Lina).
- Nov 30: Engineering intake doc for Latency analyzer (Owner: Tomas — create RFC + rough resource estimate).

Notes to self / rough signal map:
- Ticket grouping: latency-spike (13), pin-confusion (9), embeddings-stale (6), dedicated-capacity (8).
- Propose pilot customers for Latency analyzer: two SMBs and one enterprise who reported repeat tail events (ask solutions-eng to outreach).

Unresolved / hypotheses to validate:
- Hypothesis: most latency tails are due to model-switch + kv-cache warmup rather than infra flakiness. Validate by instrumenting model-switch span on next 2 weeks.
- Hypothesis: customers misinterpret "pinning" because Console copy implies permanence. Quick validation: A/B test a revised tooltip and measure support tickets referencing pinning.

Appendix: links and IDs for follow-up
- Sample tickets: JIRA-2198, JIRA-2201, JIRA-2219
- Internal notes: https://confluence.internal/redwood/cs/latency-tail-jun-2026
- Owner slack channel: #cs-runtime-feedback

If anyone reading: add any missing voice snippets below and flag any customer you'd like included in the pilot outreach.

-- Aisha
